name: Pathao Courier
coverage: All 64 districts, with nationwide home delivery.
codSupport: Yes — 1% outside Dhaka. Published Dhaka rates conflict between 0.5% and 1%, so confirm the applicable Dhaka rate before pricing orders.
pricing: Same city or district (24h) BDT 60–90; Dhaka metro to Narayanganj, Gazipur, Keraniganj or Savar (72h) BDT 80–130; Dhaka or those suburbs to outside Dhaka, or the reverse (72h) BDT 110–170; between two different cities outside Dhaka (72h) BDT 120–180. Extra charge applies above 2 kg; rates exclude VAT and tax.
returnHandling: Outside Dhaka, returned parcels add 50% of the delivery charge; Dhaka-to-Dhaka returns have no return fee, except partial and exchange deliveries. Reverse logistics supports customer returns and exchanges.
api: Yes — merchants can connect a website through the Developer API option in the merchant panel.
applicationPath: Register at merchant.pathao.com/register with business name, owner name, mobile and email, then add store and payout details.
notes: A nationwide e-commerce courier with doorstep pickup and delivery, live tracking, COD, returns, fulfilment and a Dhaka same-day option. Its merchant panel and API suit online sellers that want delivery booking and tracking connected to their store.

name: Paperfly
coverage: Same city, periphery/suburb and rest of Bangladesh. Parcels up to 8 kg.
codSupport: Yes — 0% COD charge for same-city delivery, 1% for periphery/suburb and rest of Bangladesh, on the collected amount.
pricing: Standard up to 1 kg: BDT 70 same city, BDT 110 periphery/suburb, BDT 130 rest of Bangladesh. BDT 20 per additional kg. Charges include VAT and tax.
returnHandling: No additional return charge — only one attempted delivery charge applies. Exchange and partial delivery add 50% of the delivery charge on top of one forward charge.
applicationPath: Register online, then book and manage deliveries through the merchant panel.
notes: A nationwide e-commerce logistics provider offering doorstep pickup and delivery, COD collection, exchanges, fulfilment, warehousing and merchant payouts. Its current rate card includes 0% same-city COD and no separate return charge, which is useful for sellers with a high share of COD orders.

name: eCourier
coverage: Inside Dhaka, outside Dhaka metro, and thana/union areas.
codSupport: Yes — inside Dhaka: 1% of the COD amount or BDT 10, whichever is higher; outside Dhaka: 2% or BDT 20, whichever is higher.
pricing: Up to 1 kg: inside Dhaka next-day standard (24–48h) BDT 80; outside Dhaka metro (3–4 days) BDT 130; outside Dhaka thana/union (5–7 days) BDT 160. Each additional kg adds BDT 30.
returnHandling: NDR (non-delivery report) management is included on both Standard and Express plans; return timing and charges are not publicly stated.
api: Express plan only — the Standard plan lists no API access.
applicationPath: Sign up online; the Express plan has a two-month minimum term.
notes: An e-commerce delivery platform with COD reconciliation, non-delivery management, label printing, tracking and automated customer messages. The Standard plan is self-service; Express adds multiple pickup addresses, API access, setup assistance and optional dedicated account management.

name: Steadfast Courier
codSupport: Yes — 1% cash-handling and risk-management charge after delivery charges are deducted.
pricing: Up to 1 kg: BDT 70 inside Dhaka, BDT 100 in Dhaka suburbs and BDT 130 outside Dhaka. The calculator notes a BDT 80 minimum for pick-and-drop service; VAT and tax are excluded.
returnHandling: No separate charge for returned parcels; delivery charges still apply to every parcel handed over, including cancelled shipments.
applicationPath: Sign up as a merchant on steadfast.com.bd.
notes: A nationwide merchant courier providing pickup, home or hub delivery, COD collection, returns, warehousing, packaging and shipment tracking. Published 1 kg reference rates are available, and returned parcels do not incur a separate return fee, although the delivery charge still applies.

name: REDX
codSupport: Yes — 0% inside Dhaka and 1% outside Dhaka.
pricing: Calculated by pickup area, delivery area, weight and COD amount through the website or developer API; no static public rate card.
returnHandling: Rejected parcels and parcels with invalid recipient details are returned to the merchant; the public policy allows up to 15 days. Return charges are not publicly stated.
api: Yes — an open developer API for parcel creation, pickup stores and tracking, plus WordPress and Shopify integrations, with a sandbox environment.
notes: A technology-led parcel service for online merchants and individuals, combining nationwide delivery, next-day merchant payout and a live charge calculator. Its OpenAPI supports parcel creation, pickup-store management, tracking and charge calculation for businesses that want direct integration.

name: S.A. Paribahan
codSupport: Yes — conditional delivery can collect full or partial payment from the recipient.
api: Yes — corporate API integration for connecting an e-commerce store is advertised.
notes: A long-running branch-based courier and cargo network for documents and parcels of varied size, with conditional delivery, e-commerce express and corporate logistics services. Its parcel capacity and branch network make it relevant for bulk consignments as well as ordinary online orders.

name: Sundarban Courier Service
coverage: 600+ outlets, with 160 branches and agency offices nationwide.
codSupport: Collects the value-declared amount against e-commerce and condition parcels through its branch network.
pricing: E-commerce and condition-parcel rates are not publicly itemised; rates for some document and poly-pack services are published separately.
api: No public API is stated; a customer dashboard and Sundarban Merchant app are available.
applicationPath: Create an account with a phone number at customer.sundarbancourierltd.com, use the Sundarban Merchant app, or call 16214.
notes: A branch-based courier and cargo service covering documents, general parcels, e-commerce and condition parcels, specialised ICT shipments and international delivery. Its 600+ outlets make it useful when senders or recipients need counter access, while merchants can book and track shipments through its dashboard or app.
